Private, One-to-One Care

Cosmetic Gynaecology in Bangalore

Confidential consultations for intimate and post-pregnancy concerns in Whitefield, Bangalore. You choose what to share and when, and nothing is recommended before a private assessment.

Call the Clinic

A Private, Respectful Consultation

Intimate concerns are personal, and they can be medical, functional or cosmetic. At NeoSculpt6 the first step is a private, one-to-one consultation that clarifies your concern, your history and what you would like to change.

Where a concern needs a gynaecological, pelvic-floor, urinary or other medical opinion, that is identified before any treatment is planned. Your consultation explains the options, the alternatives and their limits, so you can decide without pressure.

Cosmetic Gynaecology Treatments

Read about each treatment privately, or book a consultation and start with a conversation.

Intimate Skin, Laser & Energy-Based Care

Non-surgical options for skin tone and tissue changes, after an assessment.

  • Intimate Pigmentation Treatment

    Pigmentation of the groin, bikini line, inner thighs and external genital skin is common and often represents normal variation.

    Explore: Intimate Pigmentation Treatment

  • Intimate Laser Treatment

    Laser-based intimate treatment applies controlled energy to selected tissues and may suit some patients after assessment.

    Explore: Intimate Laser Treatment

  • Laser Vaginal Tightening

    Changes after childbirth, menopause or ageing can affect how vaginal tissues feel, but the cause and severity vary.

    Explore: Laser Vaginal Tightening

  • Vaginal Rejuvenation Treatment

    Changes after childbirth, ageing, hormonal transition or previous procedures can affect vaginal comfort, tissue support or appearance.

    Explore: Vaginal Rejuvenation Treatment

Intimate Surgery

Elective procedures, considered only after a private consultation and, where needed, a specialist opinion.

  • Labiaplasty Surgery

    Labial size, shape and asymmetry vary naturally. Some patients seek labiaplasty because of persistent friction, irritation or discomfort, while others have an aesthetic preference they want to discuss privately.

    Explore: Labiaplasty Surgery

  • Clitoral Hood Reduction Surgery

    The clitoral hood is normal protective tissue, and its size and shape vary. Some patients seek surgery for ongoing friction, excess tissue or aesthetic preference.

    Explore: Clitoral Hood Reduction Surgery

  • Monsplasty (Mons Pubis Reduction)

    The mons pubis is the soft tissue over the pubic bone, and its natural fullness varies. Pregnancy, weight change, ageing and individual fat distribution can make it more prominent.

    Explore: Monsplasty (Mons Pubis Reduction)

  • Perineoplasty Surgery

    The perineum can change after childbirth, trauma, scarring or previous surgery, and persistent discomfort or scar-related concerns need proper clinical assessment rather than a generic recommendation.

    Explore: Perineoplasty Surgery

  • Hymenoplasty Surgery

    Hymenoplasty is an elective reconstructive procedure involving hymenal tissue. Choosing it is a personal decision, and the consultation should remain private, non-judgmental and free from cultural or moral assumptions.

    Explore: Hymenoplasty Surgery

Functional & Post-Pregnancy Concerns

Symptoms such as dryness, leakage or discomfort, which start with a medical assessment.

  • Urinary Incontinence Treatment

    Urinary incontinence means involuntary urine leakage. It can occur with coughing or exercise, with sudden urgency, or through a mixture of patterns.

    Explore: Urinary Incontinence Treatment

  • Vaginal Dryness Treatment

    Dryness can cause burning, irritation, daily discomfort or pain during intimacy. Menopause is one context, but dryness has several causes and shouldn't be assumed to be part of ageing.

    Explore: Vaginal Dryness Treatment

  • Pain During Intimacy Treatment

    Pain during sexual activity or penetration can have many causes, including dryness, tissue irritation, pelvic-floor factors, scarring, infection or other gynaecological conditions.

    Explore: Pain During Intimacy Treatment
